title: 流控型电阻：负的动态电阻
statement: 非线性电阻 N 是电流控制型的：v = i² − 3i + 4，i 单位 A，v 单位 V，取关联参考方向。只讨论 i ≥ 0 的范围。N 由 I_s = 1 A 的直流电流源供电。
求 V_Q、N 吸收的功率、静态电阻 R 和动态电阻 R_d，并判断 N 是否也是电压控制型。

questions.explain: 电流源决定 I_Q = 1 A（从上往下流过 N），V_Q = 1 − 3 + 4 = 2 V。
P = V_Q·I_Q = 2 × 1 = 2 W > 0：N 在吸收功率，虽然它的动态电阻是负的。
R_d = dv/di = 2i − 3 = −1 Ω（i = 1 A）：电流增大时电压反而下降。

questions.ask: N 是否也是电压控制型？
choices: 不是：v = 2 V 时 i 可以是 1 A，也可以是 2 A
choiceExplain: v = i² − 3i + 4 在 i = 1.5 A 处有极小值，不单调。
对。i² − 3i + 4 = 2 有两个根 i = 1 和 i = 2：同一个电压对应两个电流，i 不是 v 的单值函数，所以只是流控型（类似气体放电管的 S 形特性）。
questions.explain: 流控型电阻用电流源驱动时工作点唯一；若改用电压源驱动，可能有多个工作点。

hints: 电流源直接给出了 N 的电流。
流控型：v = h(i)。静态电阻用 V/I，动态电阻用导数 dv/di。
动态电阻 dv/di = 2i − 3，代入工作点电流。
solution: **静态电阻。** R = V_Q/I_Q = **2 Ω**（总是正的，因为 V_Q、I_Q 同号）。
**动态电阻。** R_d = dh/di = 2i − 3 = **−1 Ω**。负的动态电阻表示：在 Q 点附近电流增加时电压减小（曲线下降段）。
**分类。** h(i) 在 i = 1.5 A 处取极小值 1.75 V，不单调；v = 2 V 时 i = 1 A 或 2 A，所以 N **只是流控型**。
**检查：** h(2) = 4 − 6 + 4 = 2 V ✓（同一电压的第二个电流）。

en.title: A current-controlled resistor with negative dynamic resistance
statement: The nonlinear resistor N is current-controlled: v = i² − 3i + 4, with i in A, v in V and the passive convention. Only i ≥ 0 is considered. N is fed by a DC current source I_s = 1 A.
Find V_Q, the power absorbed by N, the static resistance R and the dynamic resistance R_d, and decide whether N is also voltage-controlled.

questions.explain: The current source fixes I_Q = 1 A (downwards through N), so V_Q = 1 − 3 + 4 = 2 V.
P = V_Q·I_Q = 2 × 1 = 2 W > 0: N absorbs power although its dynamic resistance is negative.
R_d = dv/di = 2i − 3 = −1 Ω at i = 1 A: the voltage falls as the current rises.

choices: no: at v = 2 V the current can be 1 A or 2 A
choiceExplain: v = i² − 3i + 4 has a minimum at i = 1.5 A; it is not monotonic.
Right. i² − 3i + 4 = 2 has two roots, i = 1 and i = 2: one voltage, two currents, so i is not a function of v — N is current-controlled only (like the S-shaped curve of a gas discharge tube).
questions.explain: Driven by a current source a current-controlled resistor has a unique operating point; driven by a voltage source it may have several.

hints: The current source gives N's current directly.
Current-controlled: v = h(i). Static resistance is V/I, dynamic resistance the derivative dv/di.
The dynamic resistance is dv/di = 2i − 3; insert the operating current.
solution: **Operating point.** The current source is in series with N: I_Q = I_s = 1 A, V_Q = h(1) = 1 − 3 + 4 = **2 V**; P = V_Q·I_Q = **2 W** (absorbed).
**Static resistance.** R = V_Q/I_Q = **2 Ω** (always positive when V_Q and I_Q have the same sign).
**Dynamic resistance.** R_d = dh/di = 2i − 3 = **−1 Ω**. A negative dynamic resistance means that near Q the voltage falls when the current rises (a falling part of the curve).
**Classification.** h(i) has a minimum 1.75 V at i = 1.5 A, so it is not monotonic; at v = 2 V, i = 1 A or 2 A, so N is **current-controlled only**.
**Check:** h(2) = 4 − 6 + 4 = 2 V ✓ (the second current for the same voltage).
